text:
sam: FYI the runtime examples page's curl snippet for batching points to a dead gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood-inference/batching-example -> 404 when trying to open. this breaks the quickstart try-it flow. who owns the runtime examples doc?
ellie: I look after runtime examples. thanks for flagging. can you paste the failing URL from the page (or the exact snippet)?
sam: snippet in question: `curl https://gist.github.com/redwood-inference/batching-example/raw -o batch.sh && bash batch.sh` the gist is gone. proposing to replace with an inline minimal example and add a tiny unit test in docs/linkcheck to ensure external gist links return 200.
ryan: i can take the grep across other pages and i18n folders for missing gist links. might be a few more gone after the migration.
ellie: small replacement PR is fine. prefer we vendor a 10-line example into the repo instead of depending on external gist. if you open the PR tag me and i'll review. also add a short note: "why inline example: avoids external 3rd-party link rot".
docs-bot: created issue docs:extlink-209 "runtime examples - replace missing batching gist and add linkcheck" assigned to @sam, reported by @sam
sam: opened draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012 - in draft until i run the grep results. includes inline example + linkcheck test.
ryan: grep results: found 3 other broken gist links: guides/evangelism.md (1), guides/onboarding.md (1), i18n/fr/guides/runtime.md (1). i'll open tiny follow-ups and mark them as chore.
ellie: perfect. i'll review PR #1012 after you resolve the other small chops. thanks for catching this. :clap:
sam: will update the PR and split follow-ups. cc @ryan for follow-up PRs.
